guarded.EN: Who's asking? Names can be dangerous out here.
guarded.TL: Sino'ng nagtatanong? Ang mga pangalan ay delikado rito.

guarded.EN: Why do you need to know who I am?
guarded.TL: Bakit kailangan mong malaman kung sino ako?

guarded.EN: Just a survivor trying not to die. Leave it at that.
guarded.TL: Survivor lang na sumusubok mabuhay. Hanggang doon na lang.

guarded.EN: I don't give my background to just anyone.
guarded.TL: Hindi ko ibinibigay ang pinagmulan ko sa kahit sino.

guarded.EN: A survivor with a weapon. That's all that matters.
guarded.TL: Isang survivor na may sandata. 'Yon lang ang mahalaga.

guarded.EN: Don't pry into my identity. Keep focused on the road.
guarded.TL: Huwag mong kalkalin ang pagkatao ko. Magpokus sa kalsada.

guarded.EN: Names don't keep the infected away. What do you want?
guarded.TL: Hindi itinataboy ng pangalan ang mga infected. Ano'ng gusto mo?

guarded.EN: You don't need my life story to walk beside me.
guarded.TL: Hindi mo kailangan ng kwento ng buhay ko para sumabay sa akin.

guarded.EN: I keep my identity to myself until I know I can trust you.
guarded.TL: Itinatago ko ang pagkatao ko hangga't hindi kita lubos na pinagkakatiwalaan.

guarded.EN: I am who I need to be to survive.
guarded.TL: Ako ay kung sino ang kailangan para mabuhay.

neutral.EN: I'm just a survivor trying to make it through.
neutral.TL: Isa lang akong survivor na sumusubok makaraos.

neutral.EN: I used to be someone else before all this fell apart.
neutral.TL: Ibang tao ako noon bago nagkawasak-wasak ang lahat.

neutral.EN: Just another person looking for shelter and food.
neutral.TL: Isa lang akong tao na naghahanap ng masisilungan at makakain.

neutral.EN: I'm surviving day by day, same as you.
neutral.TL: Nabubuhay ako araw-araw, tulad mo rin.

neutral.EN: Not much to tell. Just doing what it takes to live.
neutral.TL: Walang gaanong maikukwento. Ginagawa lang ang kailangan para mabuhay.

neutral.EN: I'm a survivor out here in the county.
neutral.TL: Isa akong survivor dito sa lugar.

neutral.EN: Just someone trying to stay one step ahead of the dead.
neutral.TL: Isang tao lang na sumusubok mauna sa mga patay.

neutral.EN: I've been on the road since the outbreak started.
neutral.TL: Nasa kalsada na ako simula no'ng magsimula ang outbreak.

neutral.EN: Simple survivor. That's about the extent of it.
neutral.TL: Simpleng survivor lang. Hanggang doon lang.

neutral.EN: Trying to stay breathing, same as everyone else.
neutral.TL: Sinusubukang manatiling humihinga, tulad ng iba.

warm.EN: I'm glad to share this road with you, friend.
warm.TL: Masaya akong kasama ka sa kalsadang 'to, kaibigan.

warm.EN: Just an old soul trying to do some good in a ruined world.
warm.TL: Isang simpleng tao na sumusubok gumawa ng kabutihan sa sirang mundong 'to.

warm.EN: I'm someone who values good company out here.
warm.TL: Isa akong taong nagpapahalaga sa mabuting kasama rito.

warm.EN: Call me a friend. We're in this struggle together.
warm.TL: Tawagin mo akong kaibigan. Magkasama tayo sa laban na 'to.

warm.EN: I used to have a regular life, but now I have people I care about.
warm.TL: May normal akong buhay noon, pero ngayon may mga taong mahalaga na sa akin.

warm.EN: Just someone grateful to have found you in all this chaos.
warm.TL: Nagpapasalamat lang na nakatagpo kita sa gitna ng kaguluhang ito.

warm.EN: A friend and ally. That's who I want to be for you.
warm.TL: Isang kaibigan at kakampi. 'Yan ang nais kong maging para sa'yo.

warm.EN: I'm just happy to be standing here talking to you.
warm.TL: Masaya lang ako na nakatayo rito at nakakausap ka.

warm.EN: We're partners out here. That's all that matters to me.
warm.TL: Magkasosyo tayo rito. 'Yon lang ang mahalaga sa akin.

warm.EN: A loyal companion on the long road ahead.
warm.TL: Isang tapat na kasama sa mahabang daan sa unahan.
